name: Banh cuon with shrimp ruoc
summary: Bánh cuốn ruốc tôm is a morning rice sheet with no filling, eaten with shrimp ruốc, thin cucumber, herbs, and nước lèo. It is not the filled Hanoi roll.
origin: Quảng Bình. A morning plate, not the filled Hanoi roll.
texture: The same article says the sheet is rice batter spread thin, with no filling inside.
howToEat: Eat it in the morning with shrimp ruốc, thinly cut cucumber, herbs, and nước lèo.
where: A morning plate in Đồng Hới.
seoTitle: Banh cuon ruoc tom — the Dong Hoi rice sheet
seoDescription: Bánh cuốn ruốc tôm is a rice sheet with no filling, eaten with shrimp ruốc, cucumber, and herbs.
